explorer_tables.verdict: defect: the production model job cannot select the Explorer inputs, so no release built through it carries the five files
explorer_tables.mechanism: archive_model.prepare_model_inputs adds EXPLORER_TABLES to the export only when video_records, committee_records and recording_decision_files are passed (archive_model.py explorer_inputs). archive_model_job.validate_spec has no field for any of them (OPTIONAL_TABLES = meeting_records, appearance_records), and model_arguments never passes them, so the publish path (archive_publish_job -> run_publish) cannot produce the files. Only the frozen builder (scripts/measure/explorer_tables_frozen.py, 196d25f2) and test_phase2_model_entities pass them.
explorer_tables.origin: 941c2d12 (ct-gi01) added the tables to prepare_model_inputs without a job-spec selector; 1c2b52b8 added the pins and checks
explorer_tables.owner_layer: archive_model_job (the job spec selector and model_arguments), with lake pins for video_records and committee_records and the recording-decision files
explorer_tables.ticket_fit: ct-gi01 acceptance: the actual production job configuration selects pinned lake records and runs native model/export jobs
explorer_tables.catalog: kept: the files are intended in this release (owner 2026-11-01: nothing deferred); expected_but_absent stays a finding

recordings_tracks.verdict: ct-bxqa (the document rule reads the legacy owner record.status) plus ct-3l1c/ct-fh62, confirmed per body by tracks_trace.py, which applies the model's recording_fetch_candidates filter and recording-sources registry to the v21 and candidate captures. Gate 1 counts 2,416 matched keys: 2,145 gain first tracks, 266 change their track set, 5 lose empty tracks. The e1 figure +2,389 was keys with a track overall (1,359 -> 3,743 = +2,384) plus 5 removals; 239 of those keys are new recording keys (added-keys group). Of the 5,636 newly selected track bodies: 4,829 (2,145 + 266 keys) were not fetch candidates in v21 only because http_status was NULL (status unread); 807 (807 keys gaining a first track) were fetch candidates in v21 but for another video key: senate/captions rows at status 200 whose URL extracts a different key, so the body was a track of that other recording only. In every case the rows that now qualify for the key are senate/players rows whose v21 http_status was NULL and is 200 in the candidate, outcome stored on both sides (22,559 rows, joined by receipt line). No qualifying row changed URL or outcome. Raw read: 3 senate/players lines (2026-09-29 assemble 9608-9610) state record.status 200; the other rows were compared in captures only.
recordings_tracks.added_keys_verdict: 244 Senate keys whose only content is newly good m3u8 tracks (ct-bxqa, same per-body trace). youtube:j9R9hzq75ug (1): it enters through recording_video_links (a page linking the video, no page meeting, hence empty event_ids). The page is its own watch page, body dbd29f4e, receipts/youtube/watch-pages/2026-09-29/assemble-20260930.jsonl.gz lines 1-2. The readings are identical in v21 and the candidate (html 2cd57b09), but the capture rows go from http_status NULL to 200. The raw line 1 states record.status 200 for that sha256. So: ct-bxqa.
